title: Build real computer and task inspector
description: Implement the collapsible inspector using only current computer and task data. Filter task provenance for direct bots and label organization tasks honestly for named channels.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Implemented locally using existing APIs only: computer identity/state/policy/generation plus task status, evidence, close reason, and bot provenance. Named-channel tasks are labeled organization tasks because tasks have no channel relationship. Not merged or deployed.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Complete in PR #346, squash commit 3fb29a57457df450a2f27d120ca9f126c279e6f1. The green development deployments now serve the real computer and task inspector.
